kindDescription: {kind, select, openai {Official OpenAI API.} anthropic {Native Anthropic Messages API.} openrouter {One key for hundreds of models.} openrouter_eu {OpenRouter with EU in-region routing.} xai {Grok over the xAI API.} typesafe {Jev decision model over the TypeSafe API.} openai_compat {vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible server.} codex {Sign in with ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Business. Chat requests use the plan's Codex limits.} grok_build {Sign in with SuperGrok or X Premium+. Requests use the subscription's Grok limits.} claude {Sign in with Claude Pro or Max. Requests use the plan's Claude Code limits.} antigravity {Sign in with a Google account that has Antigravity access. Requests use the plan's Gemini and Claude quota.} moonshot {Kimi models over the global Kimi API Platform (platform.kimi.ai, api.moonshot.ai).} moonshot_cn {Kimi models over the China Kimi API Platform (platform.kimi.com, api.moonshot.cn).} kimi {Sign in with an account on the China Kimi site (kimi.com) that has a Kimi Code plan. Requests use the plan's Kimi Code limits.} kimi_ai {Sign in with an account on the global Kimi site (kimi.ai) that has a Kimi Code plan. Requests use the plan's Kimi Code limits.} meta {Muse models over a Meta Model API key (api.meta.ai).} muse_code {Sign in with a Meta account that has Muse Code. Requests use the subscription's Muse limits.} gemini {Gemini models with an AI Studio API key: chat with tools, images, and thinking, plus embeddings and image generation.} vertex {Gemini, Claude, Imagen, and partner models in your Google Cloud project, with a service account key or an express mode API key.} devin {Sign in with a Devin account. Requests use the models and daily and weekly quota of that account.} other {}}

policy.title: Data policy
policy.hint: Model templates use these facts to select models. Enter what your agreement with this provider covers.
policy.zdrHint: The provider stores no prompts or outputs under your agreement.
policy.retentionHint: How long the provider keeps prompts and outputs. Leave empty if unknown.
policy.noTrainingHint: The provider does not use prompts or outputs to train models.
policy.retentionChip: {days, plural, one {# day retention} other {# days retention}}

vertex.serviceAccountHint: Paste the JSON key of a service account with the Vertex AI User role, or upload the file. LLM Hub stores it sealed and never shows it again.
vertex.serviceAccountKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
vertex.serviceAccountInvalid: This is not a service account JSON key.
vertex.serviceAccountTooLarge: A service account key is at most {size}.
vertex.projectHint: Taken from the key. Change it to use the service account in another project.
vertex.locationHint: global, a region such as us-central1 or europe-west4, or the multi-region us or eu. Claude and partner models are only offered in some locations.
vertex.apiKeyHint: An API key from Vertex AI express mode. It reaches Gemini models only; Claude, partner models, and Imagen need a service account.
